scopes.why: Read the current Supabase auth session (getSession) to expose the signed-in user via useAuth() and attach the session JWT to requests.
Sign the user out (auth.signOut) when the app calls useAuth().signOut().
Upload objects to a Storage bucket on behalf of the signed-in user when the app calls useStorage().upload().
Remove objects from a Storage bucket when the app calls useStorage().remove().
Open a Realtime broadcast channel (channel/subscribe) so useLive() receives events; closed via removeChannel on unsubscribe.
